items.title: Harry Potter (Saga)
items.author: J. K. Rowling
items.description: The seven-book saga of the boy wizard's coming of age at Hogwarts and his fight against Lord Voldemort.

items.title: Divergent
items.author: Veronica Roth
items.description: In a faction-divided future Chicago, Tris discovers she is Divergent — and that the truth threatens the whole system.

items.title: The Hunger Games
items.author: Suzanne Collins
items.description: Katniss Everdeen volunteers for a televised fight to the death and becomes the spark of a rebellion against the Capitol.

items.title: Dracula
items.author: Bram Stoker
items.description: The epistolary classic that defined the vampire myth, as Count Dracula spreads his curse from Transylvania to England.

items.author: George Orwell
items.description: Orwell's chilling vision of a totalitarian state where surveillance, propaganda, and Big Brother crush all dissent.
